name: thematthub
description: Skills for Claude Code from real project work: writing, document export, publishing repositories, shareable web pages, agent coordination, plant data and LLM integration.

plugins.name: writing-toolkit
plugins.description: Write texts a reader can follow without the author: handbooks, documentation sites, research papers, Italian texts, competitor analyses.

plugins.name: repo-publishing
plugins.description: Turn a private repository into a safe public release, and cut versioned releases with draft notes.

plugins.name: web-pages
plugins.description: Build shareable HTML pages (dashboards, viewers, monitors, reports) and choose interface colours that are validated instead of eyeballed.

plugins.name: docs-export
plugins.description: Export a project's markdown documentation to Word and PDF, with your own templates and rendered Mermaid diagrams.

plugins.name: agent-waves
plugins.description: Advanced: coordinate several subagents on one repository in waves, with worktrees, briefs, independent checks and unattended runs.

plugins.name: plant-data
plugins.description: Connect apps, simulations and digital twins to plant systems (OPC UA, MQTT, MES, historians) safely.

plugins.name: llm-integration
plugins.description: Add language-model calls to an app: provider-agnostic client, validated JSON output, local models, a fake for tests.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: Make presentations: brief and structure by kind, design in Claude Slides, finish and edit natively in PowerPoint, build on company templates.

plugins.name: system1
plugins.description: Guided setup, diagnosis and provider development for the System-1 gateway: fast decisions for Claude Code from local models.
